Material positive since June 9: at HPE Discover 2026 (June 15-18) HPE shipped its first unified Juniper-based AI networking stack, raised its FY2026 cumulative 'Networks for AI' order target to $1.7-1.9B, cited AI backlog above $5B, and launched new QFX switches (UALink-capable, an AMD Helios rack tray, Trident5-based QFX5140 for inference) plus a Vera CPU ProLiant server. This deepens the AI-server/networking thesis on top of the pre-June-9 FQ2 guidance raise. The +2% move is benign.
